Article: Update practice details, locations, and provider identifiers
To keep your billing and demographics accurate, administrators can update practice profiles, service locations, and provider identifiers at any time.

### Steps to Update Practice Information
1. Navigate to **Admin > Practice Setup**.
2. Select the **Details & Tax ID** tab to modify your legal business name, physical address, or federal Tax ID.
3. Open the **Locations** tab to add or edit physical service addresses and assign unique location NPI numbers.
4. Go to **Admin > Providers**, click a staff member's name, and update their individual NPI and taxonomy codes in the **Billing Identifiers** section.
5. Click **Save Changes** at the bottom of each page.

### Limits and Conditions
Only users with the Administrator role can modify practice-level settings and tax identifiers. Changes apply immediately to new drafts, but do not automatically retroactively update claims already generated or queued.

### Troubleshooting
If updated practice information does not appear on outgoing claims, verify that the specific billing location is correctly linked under **Billing > Claim Defaults**. If the issue persists, clear your browser cache or contact support with the affected claim ID.

Ticket:
URGENT: Practice address updates not showing on claims and patients waiting

Listen, I have a waiting room full of patients right now and nothing is working correctly! I tried to update our practice tax ID and location address in the settings earlier, but now none of our outgoing claims are showing the new information and everything is getting rejected. I am completely lost on where this data needs to be changed so our claims actually go out with the right identifiers. Please call me back immediately.

{
  "draft": "Hi [Customer Name],

I’m sorry to hear you’re experiencing issues with the practice address and tax ID not appearing on outgoing claims. I’ve escalated this to a member of our support team, and they will be reviewing the details right away.

In the meantime, you may want to verify a few settings to ensure the updated information is applied to your claims:

1. Confirm that the practice address and tax ID were saved under **Admin > Practice Setup > Details & Tax ID**.
2. Check that the correct billing location is linked in **Billing > Claim Defaults** for the claims you are submitting.
3. If the location information was updated, make sure the changes are reflected in the **Locations** tab and that each location has the appropriate NPI assigned.
4. Clear your browser cache or try a different browser to rule out any caching issues.
5. If the problem persists, please have the affected claim IDs ready for our support specialist when they follow up.

A support specialist will be in touch shortly to help resolve this.

Thank you for your patience,
[Your Name]
Support Team"
}
